claims: No. 4-seed Oklahoma defeated No. 5-seed Michigan State 77-71 on March 22, 2026.
Oklahoma advanced to the Women's NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
The game was in Norman, Oklahoma.
Oklahoma advances to the Sweet 16 to play the winner of South Carolina/USC.
Raegan Beers had 18 points and 14 rebounds.
Aaliyah Chavez had 18 points and 6 assists.
Kennedy Blair had 14 points and 6 steals.
Grace VanSlooten had 13 points and 7 rebounds.
Oklahoma led by 8-10 points late in the fourth quarter.
A late Michigan State rally fell short.
The matchup was a second-round matchup.
